svg.desc: \begin{aligned} & Ax = \lambda_1 x,\quad Ay = \lambda_2 y \quad \left(\lambda_1 \neq \lambda_2 \,\wedge\, x, y \neq \vec{0}\right) \\ & (Ax)^H = (\lambda_1 x)^H \\ & x^H A^H = \lambda_1 x^H,\quad x^H A = \lambda_1 x^H \\ & x^H A y = \lambda_1 x^H y \\ & \lambda_2 x^H y = \lambda_1 x^H y \\ & (\lambda_2 - \lambda_1)\,x^H y = 0 \\ & x^H y = 0,\quad x \perp y \end{aligned}
